notes.title: Update notes for Oct 18
notes.notes:
Fixed PvP crash on game over
 Better leaderboards display logic - Global scores displayed at gameover only if player's current score has beaten the existing score
 Tidied up controls cheat sheet

notes.title: Update notes for Sep 2
notes.notes:
Added the setting to adjust high vegetation density. Players who feel the vegetation is too distracting may find this useful. The setting is located in Settings > High Vegetation. It can be set to one of the following options: 


 FULL (default) - all generated high vegetation is displayed, as it was prior to this update
 MEDIUM - high vegetation reduced to 50%
 SPARSE - high vegetation reduced to 10%
 OFF - no high vegetation, except for owl trees

notes.title: Update notes for Jun 19
notes.notes:
local high scores and gameplay settings no longer reset by updates

 additional minor bugfixes
